_note: Probe designs for run_integer_probe.py. IMP-4 (Sprint 18 retrospective): these were a module constant, so running ONE design required monkeypatching the list from a throwaway script. That is fine for a careful operator and dangerous when the thing being selected costs metered seconds. A config file can be edited, reviewed and diffed before an approval stop. ORDERING: by variable count, which is the cost driver -- so the file is also ordered cheapest-first, with the exception that a held design may appear anywhere.
